fields.help: Opened in a new tab of your connected browser.
fields.label: Start URL

fields.help: What to achieve in plain language — include every value to enter. The run stops at DONE or BLOCKED.
fields.label: Goal

fields.help: Falls back to the profile's vault secret `typesafe`, then TYPESAFE_API_KEY.
fields.label: TypeSafe API Key

fields.help: Name → value pairs typed into matching fields instead of asking the text runtime. Jev sees only the names (typed values are shown to it as <value:NAME>). @secret: values need an email/tel field or one whose label names the value (password inputs are never observed).
fields.label: Values

fields.help: Paths of files from this machine. Each time a click on an Upload button asks for a file chooser it is answered with the next file (an input that takes several gets all that are left) and the native dialog never opens. A run an AI started may only do this on local pages or at full-no-approvals； elsewhere use monoagentcli browser upload.
fields.label: Files

fields.help: Adds the profile's Info page (first_name, email, address…) to the values by key. ID and bank numbers are kept as secrets and photos and the card are never used. Values you list yourself win.
fields.label: Use Profile Info

fields.help: Local agent that writes TYPE_TEXT values (monoagentcli agent scan --installed).
fields.label: Text Runtime

fields.help: Model for the text runtime； a small one (e.g. haiku) keeps runs fast.
fields.label: Text Model

fields.help: Browser actions per run (decisions are capped at twice this).
fields.label: Max Actions

fields.help: Error the node unless the run ends DONE (otherwise status is on the item).
fields.label: Fail When Not Done

outputs.description: the input item's fields, passed through
